fullText.simplified:
第13章、生气

    晚上，妹妹在为租客们弹钢琴。床底的高尔听到了，他听得很认真。
    真好听，太美了。这是世界上最好听的声音，也是高尔最喜欢的声音。高尔想起以前，每个星期天的上午，漂亮的妹妹都会给大家弹钢琴。爸爸和妈妈坐在客厅里，一边听一边吃水果。他坐在妹妹旁边，看着妹妹的手在钢琴上弹来弹去。他看不懂，但听得懂。他听得很认真，觉得幸福极了。是的，那个时候的高尔幸福极了。
    租客们不会弹钢琴。他们听了一会儿，然后就没有了兴趣。虽然他们还看着妹妹，但他们只是在看她的脸。
    “真漂亮！你多大了？有男朋友吗？”他们一边喝酒，一边笑着问妹妹。
    高尔没有听到妹妹的声音，回答的人是爸爸：“我女儿十六岁了，还没有男朋友。”
    “是吗？我也没有女朋友，你觉得我做你的男朋友怎么样？”一个租客问，另外两个租客马上哈哈大笑。
    爸爸没有说话。高尔听到了妈妈的声音：“我女儿还小，现在还不想找男朋友。您是个优秀的人，以后会找到更漂亮的女朋友。”
    “是吗？但我就是喜欢她。十六岁不小了，我喜欢十六岁的女孩子！”
    三个租客一起哈哈大笑。
    笑声太大了，床底的高尔红了眼睛，他生气极了！
    三个月了，高尔变成甲虫有三个月了。但是，这三个月里高尔都没有这么生气过！高尔二十三岁了，这二十三年里，高尔也没有这么生气过！
    生气的他好像一下子有了力气，他从床底爬了出来，向门边爬去。
    他爬到了门把手上，用力把门打开了。
fullText.traditional:
第13章、生氣

    晚上，妹妹在為租客們彈鋼琴。床底的高爾聽到了，他聽得很認真。
    真好聽，太美了。這是世界上最好聽的聲音，也是高爾最喜歡的聲音。高爾想起以前，每個星期天的上午，漂亮的妹妹都會給大家彈鋼琴。爸爸和媽媽坐在客廳裡，一邊聽一邊吃水果。他坐在妹妹旁邊，看著妹妹的手在鋼琴上彈來彈去。他看不懂，但聽得懂。他聽得很認真，覺得幸福極了。是的，那個時候的高爾幸福極了。
    租客們不會彈鋼琴。他們聽了一會兒，然後就沒有了興趣。雖然他們還看著妹妹，但他們只是在看她的臉。
    “真漂亮！你多大了？有男朋友嗎？”他們一邊喝酒，一邊笑著問妹妹。
    高爾沒有聽到妹妹的聲音，回答的人是爸爸：“我女兒十六歲了，還沒有男朋友。”
    “是嗎？我也沒有女朋友，你覺得我做你的男朋友怎麼樣？”一個租客問，另外兩個租客馬上哈哈大笑。
    爸爸沒有說話。高爾聽到了媽媽的聲音：“我女兒還小，現在還不想找男朋友。您是個優秀的人，以後會找到更漂亮的女朋友。”
    “是嗎？但我就是喜歡她。十六歲不小了，我喜歡十六歲的女孩子！”
    三個租客一起哈哈大笑。
    笑聲太大了，床底的高爾紅了眼睛，他生氣極了！
    三個月了，高爾變成甲蟲有三個月了。但是，這三個月裡高爾都沒有這麼生氣過！高爾二十三歲了，這二十三年裡，高爾也沒有這麼生氣過！
    生氣的他好像一下子有了力氣，他從床底爬了出來，向門邊爬去。
    他爬到了門把手上，用力把門打開了。

sentences.simplified: 晚上，妹妹在为租客们弹钢琴。
sentences.traditional: 晚上，妹妹在為租客們彈鋼琴。
sentences.pinyin: wǎn shang mèi mei zài wèi zū kè men tán gāng qín
sentences.english: In the evening, Gao Er’s little sister was playing the piano for the tenants.

sentences.simplified: 床底的高尔听到了，他听得很认真。
sentences.traditional: 床底的高爾聽到了，他聽得很認真。
sentences.pinyin: chuáng dǐ de gāo ěr tīng dào le tā tīng de hěn rèn zhēn
sentences.english: Gao Er, who was under the bed, heard it. He listened very carefully.

sentences.simplified: 真好听，太美了。
sentences.traditional: 真好聽，太美了。
sentences.pinyin: zhēn hǎo tīng tài měi le
sentences.english: The sound was so pleasant, so beautiful.

sentences.simplified: 这是世界上最好听的声音，也是高尔最喜欢的声音。
sentences.traditional: 這是世界上最好聽的聲音，也是高爾最喜歡的聲音。
sentences.pinyin: zhè shì shì jiè shang zuì hǎo tīng de shēng yīn yě shì gāo ěr zuì xǐ huan de shēng yīn
sentences.english: This was the most beautiful sound in the world, and it was also Gao Er’s favorite sound.

sentences.simplified: 高尔想起以前，每个星期天的上午，漂亮的妹妹都会给大家弹钢琴。
sentences.traditional: 高爾想起以前，每個星期天的上午，漂亮的妹妹都會給大家彈鋼琴。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr xiǎng qǐ yǐ qián měi ge xīng qī tiān de shàng wǔ piào liang de mèi mei dōu huì gěi dà jiā tán gāng qín
sentences.english: Gao Er remembered that in the past, every Sunday morning, his beautiful little sister would play the piano for everyone.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸和妈妈坐在客厅里，一边听一边吃水果。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸和媽媽坐在客廳裡，一邊聽一邊吃水果。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba hé mā ma zuò zài kè tīng lǐ yì biān tīng yì biān chī shuǐ guǒ
sentences.english: His father and mother would sit in the living room, and they would eat fruit while listening.

sentences.simplified: 他坐在妹妹旁边，看着妹妹的手在钢琴上弹来弹去。
sentences.traditional: 他坐在妹妹旁邊，看著妹妹的手在鋼琴上彈來彈去。
sentences.pinyin: tā zuò zài mèi mei páng biān kàn zhe mèi mei de shǒu zài gāng qín shang tán lái tán qù
sentences.english: He would sit next to his little sister and watch her fingers dance across the piano keys.

sentences.simplified: 他看不懂，但听得懂。
sentences.traditional: 他看不懂，但聽得懂。
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn bù dǒng dàn tīng de dǒng
sentences.english: He couldn’t understand by watching, but he could understand by listening.

sentences.simplified: 他听得很认真，觉得幸福极了。是的，那个时候的高尔幸福极了。
sentences.traditional: 他聽得很認真，覺得幸福極了。是的，那個時候的高爾幸福極了。
sentences.pinyin: tā tīng de hěn rèn zhēn jué de xìng fú jí le shì de nà ge shí hou de gāo ěr xìng fú jí le
sentences.english: He would listen very attentively and would feel extremely blessed. Yes, Gao Er was very blessed at that time.

sentences.simplified: 租客们不会弹钢琴。他们听了一会儿，然后就没有了兴趣。
sentences.traditional: 租客們不會彈鋼琴。他們聽了一會兒，然後就沒有了興趣。
sentences.pinyin: zū kè men bú huì tán gāng qín tā men tīng le yí huì'r rán hòu jiù méi yǒu le xìng qù
sentences.english: The tenants didn’t know how to play the piano. They listened for a while, and then lost interest.

sentences.simplified: 虽然他们还看着妹妹，但他们只是在看她的脸。
sentences.traditional: 雖然他們還看著妹妹，但他們只是在看她的臉。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán tā men hái kàn zhe mèi mei dàn tā men zhǐ shì zài kàn tā de liǎn
sentences.english: Although they were still looking at Gao Er’s little sister, they were only looking at her face.

sentences.simplified: “真漂亮！你多大了？有男朋友吗？”
sentences.traditional: “真漂亮！你多大了？有男朋友嗎？”
sentences.pinyin: zhēn piào liang nǐ duō dà le yǒu nán péng you ma
sentences.english: “So pretty! How old are you? Do you have a boyfriend?”

sentences.simplified: 他们一边喝酒，一边笑着问妹妹。
sentences.traditional: 他們一邊喝酒，一邊笑著問妹妹。
sentences.pinyin: tā men yì biān hē jiǔ yì biān xiào zhe wèn mèi mei
sentences.english: They were drinking and laughing as they asked Gao Er’s little sister.

sentences.simplified: 高尔没有听到妹妹的声音，
sentences.traditional: 高爾沒有聽到妹妹的聲音，
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr méi yǒu tīng dào mèi mei de shēng yīn
sentences.english: Gao Er didn’t hear his little sister’s voice.

sentences.simplified: 回答的人是爸爸：“我女儿十六岁了，还没有男朋友。”
sentences.traditional: 回答的人是爸爸：“我女兒十六歲了，還沒有男朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: huí dá de rén shì bà ba wǒ nǚ ér shí liù suì le hái méi yǒu nán péng you
sentences.english: The person who answered was their father, “My daughter is sixteen years old, and she doesn’t have a boyfriend yet.”

sentences.simplified: “是吗？我也没有女朋友，你觉得我做你的男朋友怎么样？”
sentences.traditional: “是嗎？我也沒有女朋友，你覺得我做你的男朋友怎麼樣？”
sentences.pinyin: shì ma wǒ yě méi yǒu nǚ péng you nǐ jué de wǒ zuò nǐ de nán péng you zěn me yàng
sentences.english: “Really? I don’t have a girlfriend either. What do you think about me being your boyfriend?”

sentences.simplified: 一个租客问，另外两个租客马上哈哈大笑。
sentences.traditional: 一個租客問，另外兩個租客馬上哈哈大笑。
sentences.pinyin: yí ge zū kè wèn lìng wài liǎng ge zū kè mǎ shàng hā hā dà xiào
sentences.english: One tenant asked this, and the other two tenants immediately burst into laughter.

sentences.simplified: 爸爸没有说话。
sentences.traditional: 爸爸沒有說話。
sentences.pinyin: bà ba méi yǒu shuō huà
sentences.english: Their father did not say anything.

sentences.simplified: 高尔听到了妈妈的声音：“我女儿还小，现在还不想找男朋友。
sentences.traditional: 高爾聽到了媽媽的聲音：“我女兒還小，現在還不想找男朋友。
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr tīng dào le mā ma de shēng yīn wǒ nǚ ér hái xiǎo xiàn zài hái bù xiǎng zhǎo nán péng you
sentences.english: Gao Er heard his mother’s voice, “My daughter is still young. She doesn’t want a boyfriend yet.

sentences.simplified: 您是个优秀的人，以后会找到更漂亮的女朋友。”
sentences.traditional: 您是個優秀的人，以後會找到更漂亮的女朋友。”
sentences.pinyin: nín shì ge yōu xiù de rén yǐ hòu huì zhǎo dào gèng piào liang de nǚ péng you
sentences.english: You are an outstanding person. In the future, you will find an even more beautiful girlfriend.”

sentences.simplified: “是吗？但我就是喜欢她。十六岁不小了，我喜欢十六岁的女孩子！”
sentences.traditional: “是嗎？但我就是喜歡她。十六歲不小了，我喜歡十六歲的女孩子！”
sentences.pinyin: shì ma dàn wǒ jiù shì xǐ huan tā shí liù suì bù xiǎo le wǒ xǐ huan shí liù suì de nǚ hái zi
sentences.english: “Really? But I like her. Sixteen is not young, I like sixteen-year-old girls!”

sentences.simplified: 三个租客一起哈哈大笑。
sentences.traditional: 三個租客一起哈哈大笑。
sentences.pinyin: sān ge zū kè yì qǐ hā hā dà xiào
sentences.english: The three tenants laughed heartily together.

sentences.simplified: 笑声太大了，床底的高尔红了眼睛，他生气极了！
sentences.traditional: 笑聲太大了，床底的高爾紅了眼睛，他生氣極了！
sentences.pinyin: xiào shēng tài dà le chuáng dǐ de gāo ěr hóng le yǎn jing tā shēng qì jí le
sentences.english: Their laughter was too loud. Under the bed, Gao Er’s eyes reddened. He was extremely angry!

sentences.simplified: 三个月了，高尔变成甲虫有三个月了。
sentences.traditional: 三個月了，高爾變成甲蟲有三個月了。
sentences.pinyin: sān ge yuè le gāo ěr biàn chéng jiǎ chóng yǒu sān ge yuè le
sentences.english: It had been three months. It had been three months since Gao Er turned into a beetle.

sentences.simplified: 但是，这三个月里高尔都没有这么生气过！
sentences.traditional: 但是，這三個月裡高爾都沒有這麼生氣過！
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì zhè sān ge yuè lǐ gāo ěr dōu méi yǒu zhè me shēng qì guò
sentences.english: But, in these three months, Gao Er had never been this angry!

sentences.simplified: 高尔二十三岁了，这二十三年里，高尔也没有这么生气过！
sentences.traditional: 高爾二十三歲了，這二十三年裡，高爾也沒有這麼生氣過！
sentences.pinyin: gāo ěr èr shí sān suì le zhè èr shí sān nián lǐ gāo ěr yě méi yǒu zhè me shēng qì guò
sentences.english: Gao Er was twenty-three years old, and in these twenty-three years, Gao Er had never been this angry!

sentences.simplified: 生气的他好像一下子有了力气，他从床底爬了出来，向门边爬去。
sentences.traditional: 生氣的他好像一下子有了力氣，他從床底爬了出來，向門邊爬去。
sentences.pinyin: shēng qì de tā hǎo xiàng yí xià zi yǒu le lì qi tā cóng chuáng dǐ pá le chu lai xiàng mén biān pá qù
sentences.english: Gao Er, angry, seemed to suddenly have gained strength. He crawled out from under the bed and crawled toward the door.

sentences.simplified: 他爬到了门把手上，用力把门打开了。
sentences.traditional: 他爬到了門把手上，用力把門打開了。
sentences.pinyin: tā pá dào le mén bǎ shou shang yòng lì bǎ mén dǎ kāi le
sentences.english: He crawled onto the door handle and forcefully opened the door.

sentence_translations: Chapter 13: Angry
In the evening, Gao Er’s little sister was playing the piano for the tenants.
Gao Er, who was under the bed, heard it. He listened very carefully.
The sound was so pleasant, so beautiful.
This was the most beautiful sound in the world, and it was also Gao Er’s favorite sound.
Gao Er remembered that in the past, every Sunday morning, his beautiful little sister would play the piano for everyone.
His father and mother would sit in the living room, and they would eat fruit while listening.
He would sit next to his little sister and watch her fingers dance across the piano keys.
He couldn’t understand by watching, but he could understand by listening.
He would listen very attentively and would feel extremely blessed. Yes, Gao Er was very blessed at that time.
The tenants didn’t know how to play the piano. They listened for a while, and then lost interest.
Although they were still looking at Gao Er’s little sister, they were only looking at her face.
“So pretty! How old are you? Do you have a boyfriend?”
They were drinking and laughing as they asked Gao Er’s little sister.
Gao Er didn’t hear his little sister’s voice.
The person who answered was their father, “My daughter is sixteen years old, and she doesn’t have a boyfriend yet.”
“Really? I don’t have a girlfriend either. What do you think about me being your boyfriend?”
One tenant asked this, and the other two tenants immediately burst into laughter.
Their father did not say anything.
Gao Er heard his mother’s voice, “My daughter is still young. She doesn’t want a boyfriend yet.
You are an outstanding person. In the future, you will find an even more beautiful girlfriend.”
“Really? But I like her. Sixteen is not young, I like sixteen-year-old girls!”
The three tenants laughed heartily together.
Their laughter was too loud. Under the bed, Gao Er’s eyes reddened. He was extremely angry!
It had been three months. It had been three months since Gao Er turned into a beetle.
But, in these three months, Gao Er had never been this angry!
Gao Er was twenty-three years old, and in these twenty-three years, Gao Er had never been this angry!
Gao Er, angry, seemed to suddenly have gained strength. He crawled out from under the bed and crawled toward the door.
He crawled onto the door handle and forcefully opened the door.
